name: Невыразимо ужасный неописуемый ужас
alt: Неописуемый ужас смущённо любуется собой в зеркале под праздничным колпачком.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink outlines, loose watercolor and gouache on warm parchment, colorful accents. One obvious visual joke, simple chunky shapes, minimal background, centered large subject with comfortable margins. Modest detail, no intricate scenery. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Clear anatomy, no extra limbs. Subject: An absurd unclassifiable lilac fuzzy dungeon blob with mismatched eyes, little antlers, a duck bill and a few curly tentacles looks bashful beneath a tiny pink party hat. One small standing mirror reflects its silly face. More funny than scary, no gore.
